# Wealth of Nations - World Economic League (generated by mod_tools/Wealth of Nations/ranking.py)

# Any country scope, monthly: the first country to tick this month computes the league.
won_world_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = won_world_done } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = won_world_done value = 1 days = 25 }
		won_world_rank = yes
		won_race_sample = yes
	}
}

won_world_rank = {
	add_to_variable = { global.won_league_tick = 1 }
	# Human players: the only countries that need their exact rank (and the AI market reads this list)
	clear_array = global.won_humans
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no exists = yes }
		add_to_array = { global.won_humans = THIS }
	}
	set_variable = { global.won_rk_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.won_world_gdp = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.won_world_mil = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready }
		add_to_variable = { global.won_rk_count = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.won_world_gdp = won_gdp }
		add_to_variable = { global.won_world_mil = won_mil_bn }
	}
	# ---- gdp
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c0 }
		var:global.won_rk_gdp_c0 = {
			set_variable = { won_pv_gdp = 1 }
			set_variable = { won_pvt_gdp = global.won_league_tick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c1 }
		var:global.won_rk_gdp_c1 = {
			set_variable = { won_pv_gdp = 2 }
			set_variable = { won_pvt_gdp = global.won_league_tick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c2 }
		var:global.won_rk_gdp_c2 = {
			set_variable = { won_pv_gdp = 3 }
			set_variable = { won_pvt_gdp = global.won_league_tick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c3 }
		var:global.won_rk_gdp_c3 = {
			set_variable = { won_pv_gdp = 4 }
			set_variable = { won_pvt_gdp = global.won_league_tick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c4 }
		var:global.won_rk_gdp_c4 = {
			set_variable = { won_pv_gdp = 5 }
			set_variable = { won_pvt_gdp = global.won_league_tick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c5 }
		var:global.won_rk_gdp_c5 = {
			set_variable = { won_pv_gdp = 6 }
			set_variable = { won_pvt_gdp = global.won_league_tick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c6 }
		var:global.won_rk_gdp_c6 = {
			set_variable = { won_pv_gdp = 7 }
			set_variable = { won_pvt_gdp = global.won_league_tick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c7 }
		var:global.won_rk_gdp_c7 = {
			set_variable = { won_pv_gdp = 8 }
			set_variable = { won_pvt_gdp = global.won_league_tick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c8 }
		var:global.won_rk_gdp_c8 = {
			set_variable = { won_pv_gdp = 9 }
			set_variable = { won_pvt_gdp = global.won_league_tick }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c9 }
		var:global.won_rk_gdp_c9 = {
			set_variable = { won_pv_gdp = 10 }
			set_variable = { won_pvt_gdp = global.won_league_tick }
		}
	}
	clear_array = global.won_rk_gdp
	clear_array = global.won_top3_gdp
	clear_array = global.won_top10_gdp
	# rank 1
	set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready  NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_rk_gdp value = THIS } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = won_gdp value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_gdp }
			set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
		add_to_array = { global.won_rk_gdp = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_c0 = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v0 = won_best }
		set_temp_variable = { won_dl = 99 }
		var:won_pick = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = won_pvt_gdp value = global.won_league_tick compare = equals } }
				set_temp_variable = { won_dl = won_pv_gdp }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { won_dl = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_d0 = won_dl }
		add_to_array = { global.won_top3_gdp = won_pick }
		add_to_array = { global.won_top10_gdp = won_pick }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v0 = 0 }
		clear_variable = global.won_rk_gdp_c0
	}
	# rank 2
	set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready  NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_rk_gdp value = THIS } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = won_gdp value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_gdp }
			set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
		add_to_array = { global.won_rk_gdp = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_c1 = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v1 = won_best }
		set_temp_variable = { won_dl = 99 }
		var:won_pick = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = won_pvt_gdp value = global.won_league_tick compare = equals } }
				set_temp_variable = { won_dl = won_pv_gdp }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { won_dl = 2 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_d1 = won_dl }
		add_to_array = { global.won_top3_gdp = won_pick }
		add_to_array = { global.won_top10_gdp = won_pick }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v1 = 0 }

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = won_pvt_fac value = global.won_league_tick compare = equals } }
				set_temp_variable = { won_dl = won_pv_fac }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { won_dl = 5 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_d4 = won_dl }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_v4 = 0 }
		clear_variable = global.won_rk_fac_c4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_fac_c0 }
		var:global.won_rk_fac_c0 = {
			set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_f0 = won_fac_fact }
			set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_n0 = won_fac_n }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_fac_c1 }
		var:global.won_rk_fac_c1 = {
			set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_f1 = won_fac_fact }
			set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_n1 = won_fac_n }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_fac_c2 }
		var:global.won_rk_fac_c2 = {
			set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_f2 = won_fac_fact }
			set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_n2 = won_fac_n }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_fac_c3 }
		var:global.won_rk_fac_c3 = {
			set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_f3 = won_fac_fact }
			set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_n3 = won_fac_n }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.won_rk_fac_c4 }
		var:global.won_rk_fac_c4 = {
			set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_f4 = won_fac_fact }
			set_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_n4 = won_fac_n }
		}
	}
	# ---- exact ranks for human players
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.won_humans
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = won_ready }
			set_temp_variable = { won_mine = won_gdp }
			set_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
			every_other_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready  check_variable = { var = won_gdp value = won_mine compare = greater_than } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { won_rank_gdp = won_r }
			set_temp_variable = { won_mine = won_gdppc }
			set_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
			every_other_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready check_variable = { won_pop_k > 1000 } check_variable = { var = won_gdppc value = won_mine compare = greater_than } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { won_rank_pc = won_r }
			set_temp_variable = { won_mine = won_arms_rev_12 }
			set_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
			every_other_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready check_variable = { won_arms_rev_12 > 0.01 } check_variable = { var = won_arms_rev_12 value = won_mine compare = greater_than } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { won_rank_arms = won_r }
			set_temp_variable = { won_mine = won_mil_bn }
			set_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
			every_other_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready  check_variable = { var = won_mil_bn value = won_mine compare = greater_than } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { won_rank_mil = won_r }
			set_temp_variable = { won_mine = won_growth_y }
			set_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
			every_other_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready check_variable = { won_gdp > 5 } check_variable = { won_growth_y > 0 } check_variable = { var = won_growth_y value = won_mine compare = greater_than } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { won_rank_growth = won_r }
			# Our faction among the factions (0 = not in a faction)
			set_variable = { won_rank_fac = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
				random_country = {
					limit = { is_faction_leader = yes OR = { tag = PREV is_in_faction_with = PREV } }
					set_temp_variable = { won_mine = won_fac_gdp }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
				every_country = {
					limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready is_faction_leader = yes check_variable = { var = won_fac_gdp value = won_mine compare = greater_than } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
				}
				set_variable = { won_rank_fac = won_r }
			}
			set_variable = { won_gdp_share = won_gdp }
			multiply_variable = { won_gdp_share = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.won_world_gdp > 0 } }
				divide_variable = { won_gdp_share = global.won_world_gdp }
			}
		}
	}
	# Economic spheres (sphere.py)
	won_sphere_tick = yes
	# Every twelfth league: the Annual World Economic Review for human players
	add_to_variable = { global.won_league_months = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.won_league_months > 11 } }
		set_variable = { global.won_league_months = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.won_humans
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = won_ready }
				won_annual_review = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: places gained (+) or lost (-) in GDP since the last review.
won_annual_review = {
	set_variable = { won_rev_change = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = won_rank_gdp_ly }
		set_variable = { won_rev_change = won_rank_gdp_ly }
		subtract_from_variable = { won_rev_change = won_rank_gdp }
	}
	set_variable = { won_rank_gdp_ly = won_rank_gdp }
	country_event = { id = won.246 days = 1 }
}

# Country scope: investment-climate bonus for a place in the league (read by won_update_climate).
won_rank_climate = {
	set_variable = { won_rank_cl = 0 }
	if = { limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_top3_gdp value = THIS } } add_to_variable = { won_rank_cl = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_top10_gdp value = THIS } } add_to_variable = { won_rank_cl = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_top10_pc value = THIS } } add_to_variable = { won_rank_cl = 4 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_in_faction = yes
			any_country = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_top1_fac value = THIS } OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } }
		}
		add_to_variable = { won_rank_cl = 3 }
	}
}

# Country scope, monthly: the five biggest arms exporters gain Market Standing.
won_rank_rewards = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_top5_arms value = THIS } }
		add_to_variable = { aon_rep = 5 }
	}
}
